what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Australia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1117 Iraqi refugees in Australia, 0.4% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in periods from 1991 to 2025, with IS, al-Mahdi Army and Ansar al-Islam among the opponents since 2004.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in some years up to 1996.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 9724 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 12157, at the end of 2003; the main years of displacement in the data are 1996 to 2006.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
These are year-end totals for Australia only, reported to UNHCR.
